tool_analysis:
Step Analysis:
- The recorded session demonstrates a Magento 1.x admin customer workflow: reach Customers grid, apply filters, export, run mass-actions, and open/edit a customer. The automation must reliably find the grid filters, mass-action controls, and per-row edit links. The recorded run provides many stable selectors and example hrefs (/admin/customer/edit/id/{id}/) and element_hash values for inputs and buttons. However exact form_key and some option values are only present in the live DOM (hidden input or JS variable) so the tool must read the live page before form POSTs.

Task Definition:
- This tool automates: 1) searching for customers by several filter fields, 2) exporting the search results, 3) applying mass-actions to selected customer IDs, 4) opening a customer's Edit page, 5) updating fields on the Edit form and saving. It is designed for Magento 1.x admin with typical selectors but reads the live DOM to get form_key and option values where needed.

Action Plan (detailed):
1) Navigate to Customers grid URL and extract initial page content (to capture form_key if present and locate massaction/export controls).
2) Fill all filter inputs using conventional Magento filter selectors (ID from/to, Name, Email, Telephone, Postcode, Group, Website, Country). Values are optional; empty values are input as empty strings to keep execution deterministic.
3) Click Search and wait for grid refresh; extract visible rows into 'search_results'.
4) If export requested, run an agent action to trigger export and capture the export URL used (handles both anchor-based and select/onchange export UIs).
5) If mass-action requested with select_ids, use an agent step to robustly locate checkboxes for the supplied IDs (using row-scoped XPath relative to edit links), set the massaction select value and submit. The agent will also read and include the form_key to avoid CSRF issues.
6) If edit_customer_id provided, navigate directly to the edit URL (deterministic) and extract the edit form. Read form_key and element names/ids for Save.
7) Fill provided update fields on the edit form and click Save; wait and extract save confirmation and the updated values.

Variable Identification (inputs):
- base_url (required): root address. All other inputs are optional filters/actions.
- filter inputs: id_from, id_to, name, email, telephone, postcode, country_id, group_id, website_id.
- export_format: CSV/Excel/XML.
- mass_action, mass_action_group_id: which mass action and its group argument.
- select_ids: list of customer IDs to target for mass actions.
- edit_customer_id and update_* fields: for opening and editing a customer record.
- current_admin_password: included because many Magento installs require current admin password for sensitive changes; marked optional here because not all installations require it.

Step Optimization and Determinism:
- Prefer direct URL navigation for opening the Edit page (constructed /admin/customer/edit/id/{id}/) to avoid flaky grid link clicks.
- For filters and form inputs, use conventional Magento name/id patterns (filter[<field>] etc.) but also include elementHash values recorded in the session as deterministic fallbacks.
- Mass-action requires reading form_key and the select option values; these are not present in the recorded text dump so an agentic step is used to inspect the live DOM and perform the mass-action reliably.
- Export can be anchor-based or select-based; the agent step finds and triggers it and returns the export URL so downstream automation can fetch the file directly if desired.

Constraints / Caveats:
- The tool assumes an authenticated admin session exists in the browser context running the steps (do not include login in the tool). If the session is not authenticated the tool will land on the login page and fail.
- Many selectors are inferred from Magento 1.x conventions; the tool captures form_key and option values at runtime to ensure POST actions succeed. If the admin frontName or custom themes change IDs/names, the agent steps will search by visible labels and href patterns.
- Deleting customers is destructive; the tool includes delete as a mass_action option but the agent will use caution and require explicit select_ids to run destructive operations.

Why agent steps are used:
- The recorded session showed several dynamic UI patterns (export select with URL option values, massaction option values and invoking form_key, selecting rows by ID). Those require DOM inspection and sometimes JS-driven behavior; agentic steps handle this dynamic reasoning and interaction while keeping the main tool deterministic for standard cases.

Outputs:
- search_results: extracted list of matching rows with edit URLs.
- export_result: export URL or result from invoked export.
- mass_action_result: outcome text and any admin notification.
- edit_page_initial / edit_save_result: captured form_key, field selectors, and save confirmation.

Version: 1.0.0
name: magento_admin_customer_tool_v1
description: Automate searching, exporting, mass-actions and editing customers in Magento Admin (Magento 1.x). Navigates to the Customers grid, applies filters, triggers export, optionally runs mass-actions, opens the Edit page for a customer, captures form_key and fills/saves provided fields. Designed from a recorded browser session on http://dockerized-magento.local/admin/customer/ and uses Magento admin conventions (grid id customerGrid, filter[name/email], edit links /admin/customer/edit/id/{id}/).

steps.description: Navigate to the Magento Admin Customers grid page.
Read the page HTML/text to capture any existing form_key, massaction form container or export links.
steps.goal: Capture the grid page and attempt to read any global form_key or visible mass-action/export controls before interacting.

steps.description: Fill ID 'From' filter (if provided).
Fill ID 'To' filter (if provided).
Fill Name filter (if provided).
Fill Email filter (if provided).
Fill Telephone filter (if provided).
Fill ZIP/Postcode filter (if provided).
Select Group filter option by visible text or value (if provided).
Select Website filter option by visible text or value (if provided).
Select Country filter by visible text (if provided).
Click the Search button to apply filters.
Wait for the grid to update after applying filters.
Capture the filtered rows and their Edit link URLs for later actions.
steps.goal: Extract visible customer rows (ID, name, email, group, website, edit link hrefs) from the updated grid.

steps.description: Export control sometimes uses an anchor href or select option. Agent will find the control and activate it or return the URL. Max steps: 4
steps.task: If export_format is provided (CSV/Excel/XML), trigger the Export control for the selected format; capture the export URL used (option value or anchor href) and return it as 'export_url'.

steps.description: Mass-action application is dynamic (row selection and option values may vary). The agent must ensure checkboxes target the correct rows and include form_key for POST actions.
steps.task: If select_ids is provided and mass_action is provided, locate and check each checkbox for the listed customer IDs (CSV list), then select the mass_action option in the massaction select, set mass_action_group_id when action is 'assign_group', click Submit and capture the mass-action result notification. Ensure form_key is present or read it from the DOM before submitting.

steps.description: If edit_customer_id is provided, navigate directly to the customer's Edit page (direct GET).
Extract hidden form_key and page metadata (customer id, group, website, existing field values).
steps.goal: Capture the Edit page DOM and attempt to read input[name='form_key'] and top action button selectors before making edits.

steps.description: Set Prefix on Edit form (if provided).
Set Middle Name/Initial on Edit form (if provided).
Set First Name (if provided).
Set Last Name (if provided).
Set Email (if provided).
Set New Password field (if provided).
Fill Current Admin Password if required by the instance to save changes.
If a target group is provided for the edit operation, set the group select to the provided visible text or value.
Click Save on the Edit form to persist changes.
Wait for save to complete and for any notifications to appear.
Return confirmation of save and latest field values.
steps.goal: Capture success/error notifications after Save, and re-read form_key and updated field values to confirm changes.

input_schema.name: base_url
input_schema.description: Base URL of the Magento site (e.g. 'http://dockerized-magento.local'). Tool will append '/index.php/admin/customer/' to reach the Customers grid.

input_schema.name: id_from
input_schema.description: Filter: ID 'From' value (numeric or string). Leave empty to skip.

input_schema.name: id_to
input_schema.description: Filter: ID 'To' value (numeric or string). Leave empty to skip.

input_schema.name: name
input_schema.description: Filter: Customer name partial match (first/last/full).

input_schema.name: email
input_schema.description: Filter: Customer email address (partial or full).

input_schema.name: telephone
input_schema.description: Filter: Telephone number (partial match).

input_schema.name: postcode
input_schema.description: Filter: ZIP / Postcode value.

input_schema.name: country_id
input_schema.description: Filter: country option value (use option value from website, e.g. 'US' or numeric id depending on site). If unknown, provide the visible country name and automation will attempt to select by visible text.

input_schema.name: group_id
input_schema.description: Filter: customer group id or visible text (e.g. 'Wholesale'). If numeric id is known, provide as string; otherwise provide visible text and tool will try to match visible option.

input_schema.name: website_id
input_schema.description: Filter: website id or visible text (e.g. 'Main Website' or '1').

input_schema.name: export_format
input_schema.description: If provided, trigger the Export for the current filtered results. Supported values: 'CSV','Excel','XML'. Leave empty to skip export.

input_schema.name: mass_action
input_schema.description: Optional mass-action to apply to selected customers. 'assign_group' requires mass_action_group_id.

input_schema.name: mass_action_group_id
input_schema.description: When mass_action is 'assign_group', the target group id or visible group name (e.g. 'VIP Member').

input_schema.name: select_ids
input_schema.description: Comma-separated list of customer IDs to select for mass-action (e.g. '204,192'). If empty, no rows will be selected; mass-action will not be applied.

input_schema.name: edit_customer_id
input_schema.description: Customer id to open in Edit mode (e.g. '204'). If provided the tool will navigate to the Edit page for this id.

input_schema.name: update_prefix
input_schema.description: If provided and edit_customer_id present, set the Prefix field to this value on the Edit form.

input_schema.name: update_middlename
input_schema.description: If provided and edit_customer_id present, set the Middle Name/Initial field.

input_schema.name: update_firstname
input_schema.description: If provided, update the customer's first name.

input_schema.name: update_lastname
input_schema.description: If provided, update the customer's last name.

input_schema.name: update_email
input_schema.description: If provided, update the customer's email address.

input_schema.name: update_password
input_schema.description: If provided, set a new password for the customer (New Password field).

input_schema.name: current_admin_password
input_schema.description: If required in your Magento instance to save edits, supply the current admin password. Many installations require this for sensitive changes; leave empty if not required.
